contract.objective: Select only a repeatable zero-additional-cash-spend local video profile that is safe and demo-usable on the measured team laptop.
contract.repository_or_artifact_revision: 90eb776 plus the uncommitted EXP-005 contract change set

reroute_recommendations: Rerun EXP-005 after the free physical RAM precondition passes.
Do not integrate a video adapter until its profile passes every blocking budget.

approved_targets: Zero additional API, subscription, trial-credit, or cloud-GPU spend
FastAPI remains the model orchestration boundary
At most 100 GB of permanent model and cache data on drive D
decisions: Qwen3 4B is the local prompt-enhancement model.
LTX-Video 2B v0.9.8 distilled is the LOCAL_STANDARD candidate.
FramePack F1 is evaluated only as an image-conditioned LOCAL_QUALITY challenger.
conflicts: The previously proposed LTX Q8 acceleration is documented for NVIDIA Ada; the measured RTX 3070 Ti is Ampere, so that path is not assumed valid.
unknowns: Exact low-memory LTX 2B runtime and checkpoint representation that works on this Ampere host
Peak committed system memory for each video worker
Human quality scores from both team members

platforms: NVIDIA RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU 8 GB
include: FramePack F1 reference-image generation if Standard passes
H.264 MP4 normalization and playback verification
Resource, timing, repeatability, footprint, provenance, and quality evidence
exclude: Production FastAPI adapter work before a candidate passes
non_goals: Claiming parity with Veo, Kling, Sora, or other premium hosted models
Native generated dialogue or synchronized audio

implementation_owners: S0ra1n0: isolated worker, model lifecycle, cancellation, and telemetry
Bruce: fixed input, Android playback evidence, and scorecard coordination

workloads.description: FastAPI enhances the fixed paper-dragon prompt through local Qwen and unloads the model.
workloads.data_profile: Synthetic English prompt without personal or secret data
workloads.concurrency: 1 request and no resident video model
workloads.correctness_oracle: HTTP success, provider ollama, usedFallback false, non-empty enhancedPrompt, and zero loaded Ollama models after the response

workloads.description: Generate the closest supported four-to-five-second clip from the fixed synthetic reference image and motion prompt using LTX-Video 2B v0.9.8 distilled.
workloads.platform: Windows, CUDA, RTX 3070 Ti Laptop 8 GB
workloads.data_profile: One fixed synthetic near-16:9 PNG, fixed prompt, seed 18426, one output at a time
workloads.concurrency: 1 worker, 1 job, and no other AI model loaded
workloads.correctness_oracle: Two consecutive non-OOM runs produce decodable H.264 MP4 files matching recorded settings and human score at least 65/100

workloads.description: Generate a five-second-or-shorter clip from the same fixed input using FramePack F1 after Standard passes.
workloads.platform: Windows, CUDA, RTX 3070 Ti Laptop 8 GB
workloads.data_profile: Same reference image, prompt intent, seed policy, duration cap, and scoring rubric as Standard
workloads.concurrency: 1 worker, 1 job, and no other AI model loaded
workloads.correctness_oracle: Two consecutive non-OOM runs produce decodable H.264 MP4 files and beat Standard by at least eight weighted quality points

environments: Exact GPU name, driver, VRAM, total/free physical RAM, drive-D free space, power state, model revision, dependency manifest, and command are captured for each run.
Model caches and outputs remain on drive D; no paid or remote inference endpoint is permitted.
warmup_and_cache: Qwen evidence records model-load time and uses keep_alive 0.
Video run 1 is cold process/cache evidence; run 2 is a fresh worker process with downloaded weights retained.
No warmup run may be silently excluded.
network_device_runtime: Generation is local; network is used only for version-pinned model/dependency download before timing.
Video timing starts immediately before worker submission and stops after a playable MP4 is finalized.
Android playback is checked separately using Media3 on emulator or device.
repetitions_and_duration: Qwen: one direct model proof plus one FastAPI proof.
Each video candidate: two consecutive complete runs, each four to five seconds where the runtime supports it.
Capture one-second RAM/VRAM telemetry during video generation.
variance_and_comparison: Use the same host, power state, fixed image, prompt intent, duration target, and one-job concurrency.
Compare both video runs individually; a median may be reported but may not conceal a threshold breach.
Both team members score anonymized outputs independently before model labels are revealed.
correctness_oracles: ffprobe reports a decodable H.264 video stream with positive duration and expected dimensions.
Android Media3 plays the final MP4 without a fatal playback error.
Composition, motion coherence, prompt adherence, reference consistency, and artifact scores sum to 100.
privacy_and_safety: Use only the committed fictional paper-dragon input and prompt.
Never record tokens, credentials, signed URLs, or unrelated process command lines.
Abort on OS instability, out-of-memory, or less than 1 GB free physical RAM at any sample.

budgets.comparison_rule: localhost request with exact configured Qwen tag and no video model loaded

budgets.target: >= 6 free physical RAM, >= 6 free VRAM, and >= 100 free on drive D
budgets.blocking_threshold: any target fails, laptop is not on AC power, or another AI model is loaded
budgets.comparison_rule: fresh one-second system and nvidia-smi observations
same fixed input, prompt intent, duration target, seed, and isolated worker conditions

budgets.aggregation: mean of Bruce and S0ra1n0 scores after both runs
budgets.comparison_rule: anonymized files scored with QUALITY_SCORECARD.md before model disclosure

budgets.metric: H.264 and Android Media3 playback acceptance
budgets.comparison_rule: ffprobe inspection plus foreground Android app playback evidence
same input intent and isolated host conditions as Standard
same anonymized two-reviewer scorecard and fixed input intent

budgets.metric: permanent model and cache footprint for accepted profiles
budgets.aggregation: sum on drive D after accepted candidates are installed
budgets.comparison_rule: resolved model/cache directories only; exclude generated evidence outputs

experiments.result: Direct Qwen generation completed in 6.39 seconds. FastAPI completed in 6.81 seconds with provider=ollama, usedFallback=false, and zero loaded models afterward.

experiments.blocker: Latest free physical RAM observation is far below the 6 GiB preflight target. Exact Ampere-safe LTX runtime manifest is still being resolved.

experiments.entry_condition: LTX Standard passes all blocking budgets and the same 6 GiB free-RAM preflight passes.

ci_gates: Validate this JSON with the skill validator.
FastAPI Ruff and Pytest remain green.
A real provider adapter cannot become the default without linked passing run evidence.
trend_evidence: Retain both runs per candidate; do not replace a failing run with only a later passing artifact.
attempt_ledger: Every model-install, load, OOM, timeout, cancellation, and completed generation attempt receives an immutable evidence entry.
failure_diagnostics: Capture exit code, stderr tail with secrets removed, peak RAM/VRAM, last successful phase, and output-file existence.

decisions_needed: Accept or reject LOCAL_STANDARD after both human reviewers score two valid LTX runs.
Retain LOCAL_QUALITY only when its measured quality delta is at least eight points.
blockers: The latest observed free physical RAM does not meet the 6 GiB video preflight gate.
No LTX or FramePack output has yet run on this laptop.
assumptions: The team can close memory-heavy applications before a scheduled experiment.
The generated benchmark image is acceptable as course-project test data.
limitations: Qwen success proves text-model orchestration only, not video generation.
Repository/model-card feasibility claims are not a substitute for local run evidence.
Reference-image performance does not by itself prove text-only video quality.
residual_risks: 16 GB total RAM may make both candidates unsafe or too slow even after applications are closed.
Runtime dependencies may require a different low-memory path on Ampere than the official Ada-oriented Q8 path.
